thread:
Iris: Heads-up: customers reported the unit-econ card showing zero cache credits during a 90s traffic spike. Warm hit counts present but credits flatline. Anyone on call?
Will: saw that too. Which route?
Iris: /v1/reply with model: redwood-alpha. Warm tokens logged but reconciled credits = 0 for the spike window.
Samira: Could be the recent commit to 'lineage-dedupe' that coalesces owners aggressively. If owner becomes NULL for a moment, reconciler may skip credits.
metrics-bot: deploy 4977777790 - lineage-service v3.1 -> v3.2 (feature: lineage_dedupe=true).
Jon: Ops note: automatic rollback triggered earlier when write errors rose; but this looks like logical fallout not write errors.
Will: Quick check: I ran an aggregate on token_events vs reconciler_output; raw_warm=9,800 tokens, reconciled=0 in the window.
Samira: Short-term fix: have reconciler emit provisional credits when owner resolution returns null. Mark provisional=true so UI can show them as interim.
Iris: Console UX: show a small "provisional" chip and a tooltip explaining why credits may be provisional during bursts. Also surface reconciler version used for the data.
Jon: Agree. Also add an alert rule: if warm_hits > 2k/min and reconciled_credits==0 for >30s alert eng-platform.
Will: I'll script a staging burst test to validate provisional emit and dedupe on final pass.
Samira: I'll land a tiny patch to emit provisional rows with TTL and reconciler_version tag. Deploy in ~90 mins.
Iris: Thanks team. Assign follow-ups: Samira implements emit, Will runs staging test, Jon adds alert, Iris will draft console copy. Keep updates here.
